project.title: Rock & Load: Expanded Reclaimer Arsenal
project.party_size_target: 1-4 (native game range; mod replication not tested)
project.release_scope: 12 new weapon concepts across ballistic, industrial, chemical, elemental and energy families
project.first_minute: Choose one new Reclaimer weapon, enter the first cave encounter, then test its primary and alternate fire against the opening enemy group.
project.balance_note: All numeric values are initial design targets, not measured or balanced against the current live game. Rebalance after inspecting the installed build and comparing vanilla weapon stats.

weapons.name: Arc Conductor
weapons.primary_fire: Rapid electrical bolts. A hit jumps to nearby enemies with reduced damage.
weapons.alternate_fire: Spend stored charge on a short-range electrical pulse that overloads nearby targets.
weapons.tradeoff: Strong against clustered enemies; inefficient against isolated targets and requires charge management.
weapons.visual_identity: Industrial coil assembly, insulated grips, copper busbars and blue-white electrical arcs.
weapons.audio_identity: Rising transformer hum followed by sharp electrical snaps.

weapons.name: Cryo Needle
weapons.primary_fire: Fire narrow cryogenic darts that build frost on one target.
weapons.alternate_fire: Spend pressure to fire a piercing ice shard that deals bonus damage to frozen targets.
weapons.tradeoff: Rewards precision and follow-up shots; weaker when spraying into a crowd.
weapons.visual_identity: Pressure rifle with frost reservoir, insulated barrel jacket and pale cyan vents.
weapons.audio_identity: Pneumatic hiss, brittle ice crack and low pressure release.

weapons.name: Rail Splitter
weapons.primary_fire: Charge and launch a dense slug that pierces a line of enemies.
weapons.alternate_fire: A quick low-charge shot with reduced damage and penetration.
weapons.tradeoff: High impact and line penetration in exchange for deliberate charge timing and scarce ammunition.
weapons.visual_identity: Long magnetic rails, warning markings, heavy rear capacitor and recoil braces.
weapons.audio_identity: Capacitor whine followed by a sharp metallic rail report.

weapons.name: Rotary Shredder
weapons.primary_fire: Belt-fed rotary cannon with a short spin-up and sustained firing cycle.
weapons.alternate_fire: Overdrive the barrel assembly for greater output while rapidly building heat.
weapons.tradeoff: Excellent sustained pressure but heavy, loud and vulnerable during spin-up or cooling.
weapons.visual_identity: Oversized rotary barrel cluster, feed belt, heat fins and mining-grade housing.
weapons.audio_identity: Mechanical spin-up, deep cyclic gunfire and cooling ticks.

weapons.name: Rivet Storm
weapons.primary_fire: Launch heavy rivets that lodge in enemies or cave surfaces.
weapons.alternate_fire: Trigger lodged rivets for a compact controlled detonation.
weapons.tradeoff: Excellent when the player plans a burst sequence; weaker while constantly repositioning.
weapons.visual_identity: Pneumatic piston block, pressure gauge, rivet hopper and scratched yellow safety panels.
weapons.audio_identity: Air-compressor thump, rapid metal impacts and compact detonation.

weapons.name: Acid Injector
weapons.primary_fire: Inject a corrosive needle that weakens target armor over time.
weapons.alternate_fire: Release a three-needle fan that spreads a weaker corrosion effect.
weapons.tradeoff: Improves squad damage against durable targets but has modest immediate burst damage.
weapons.visual_identity: Sealed chemical canister, reinforced injection chamber, hazard labels and green pressure windows.
weapons.audio_identity: Needle-launch snap and bubbling chemical hiss.

weapons.name: Magnetar Disc
weapons.primary_fire: Launch a spinning magnetic disc that ricochets between enemies and returns.
weapons.alternate_fire: Recall the disc early to alter its return path and strike targets again.
weapons.tradeoff: Can hit several targets on a planned path, but poor positioning wastes the throw window.
weapons.visual_identity: Thick steel disc, magnetic rim, warning LEDs and rugged wrist-mounted return receiver.
weapons.audio_identity: High-pitched spin, metallic ricochets and magnetic catch clack.

weapons.name: Seismic Projector
weapons.primary_fire: Emit a forward ground-hugging shockwave that staggers enemies in a cone.
weapons.alternate_fire: Compress the wave into a narrow, longer-reaching impact line.
weapons.tradeoff: Creates breathing room for the squad but loses effectiveness at long range.
weapons.visual_identity: Twin counter-rotating impact drums, reinforced muzzle plates and vibration dampers.
weapons.audio_identity: Low concussive thump with a rattling mechanical tail.

weapons.name: Gravity Well Launcher
weapons.primary_fire: Launch a gravitic charge that briefly pulls nearby small enemies toward its center.
weapons.alternate_fire: Collapse the field early in a compact implosion.
weapons.tradeoff: Sets up team area damage and interrupts movement but deals limited direct damage before collapse.
weapons.visual_identity: Heavy containment cage, floating inner core, gravity warning dials and violet distortion lens.
weapons.audio_identity: Deep spatial hum, rising pressure tone and muted implosion.

weapons.name: Thermal Lance
weapons.primary_fire: Project a continuous heat beam that builds temperature on the target and progressively weakens armor.
weapons.alternate_fire: Vent accumulated heat in a short forward flare, forcing cooldown.
weapons.tradeoff: Rewards tracking one priority target; overheating interrupts sustained damage.
weapons.visual_identity: Industrial beam emitter, ceramic cooling collars, amber core and heavy heat sinks.
weapons.audio_identity: Steady electrical whine that rises with heat, then a sharp vent hiss.

weapons.name: Magma Mortar
weapons.primary_fire: Lob a slow thermal shell that bursts on impact and leaves a brief hot zone.
weapons.alternate_fire: Compress the payload into a direct-impact slug with a smaller blast and stronger direct hit.
weapons.tradeoff: Controls chokepoints and groups but has slow projectiles and limited ammunition.
weapons.visual_identity: Short-barrel pressure mortar, ceramic shell rack, heat-shielded grips and orange vents.
weapons.audio_identity: Heavy launch thump, molten splash and cooling crackle.

weapons.name: Bore-Drill Cannon
weapons.primary_fire: Launch a powered drill head that bores through a line of enemies before losing momentum.
weapons.alternate_fire: Reverse the drill head early, pulling it back through the same corridor for a second pass.
weapons.tradeoff: Rewards lining up targets and controlling corridors; performs poorly when enemies surround the player.
weapons.visual_identity: Oversized mining drill cartridge, exposed drive gears, hydraulic braces and striped hazard shell.
weapons.audio_identity: Hydraulic kick, aggressive drilling grind and reverse motor whirr.
